title: An account people may decline
hook: Two stated cases: explore the share reached by a commitment offer.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the share reached by a commitment offer affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Added, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the share reached by a commitment offer in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
